# no-space-in-emphasis

- ID: `MD037`
- Category: Emphasis
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: yes
- Tags: `whitespace`, `emphasis`

Emphasis markers touch the text they wrap, as in \*\*bold\*\*.

## Why

With a space inside, the markers do not make emphasis and show as literal \* or
\_ characters.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

The fix deletes the spaces inside the markers. gomdlint reports a pair without a
fix when the markers may be meant literally, such as single asterisks with
spaces on both sides. It does the same inside square brackets. gomdlint may
report a finding without a fix when the fix would change a line with one
character in brackets, such as \[x\] or \[1\], or the lines around it up to a
blank line, because it could add or remove a task list checkbox.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

Run gomdlint ** before ** you commit.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
3:16 Spaces inside emphasis markers
3:23 Spaces inside emphasis markers
```

The fix changes it to:

```markdown
# Guide

Run gomdlint **before** you commit.
```

## Configure

Under `rules`, `no-space-in-emphasis: false` turns the rule off and
`no-space-in-emphasis: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-space-in-emphasis` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-space-in-emphasis -->
```
